title: Graphics Card Payback: Renting Out vs Serving Models
tools: Python data pipeline · JavaScript calculator page · Vast.ai, OpenRouter, InferenceX and GetDeploying data
blurb: A calculator for how many months a data-center GPU takes to pay for itself, renting by the hour or serving open models, across 16 cards.
long: If you buy a data-center GPU (graphics processing unit), how long until it pays for itself? The site compares renting it out by the hour with serving open models through OpenRouter, a marketplace for model APIs (application programming interfaces).
Python scripts collect rental offers, per-provider prices and traffic, and measured serving speeds, and every assumption, from electricity price to yearly price decline, is an adjustable control.
At the defaults (data as of 7 October 2026), the fastest rental payback is 17.1 months and the fastest serving payback 5.3 months, though serving revenue is limited by demand.
highlights: Fastest rental payback 17.1 months at defaults
Fastest serving payback 5.3 months at defaults
Ten adjustable assumptions, from electricity price to yearly price drop
